description: GitHub Actions workflow security audit — Audit a GitHub Actions workflow for supply-chain and injection risks: pull_request_target pwn-requests, script injection from issue/PR titles and bodies, unpinned third-party actions, missing or write-all permissions, secrets echoed in run steps, self-hosted runners on PRs, curl|bash, secrets: inherit. Pass text= (workflow YAML) or url= (raw or GitHub blob URL). Returns PASS/REVIEW/FAIL, 0-100 score, findings with line numbers and fixes, and the action pin list. Offline static scan. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
